en.t: So that was it, it was a trap all along! ...

units.source_text: 原来那些家伙瞄准的不是海，而是这里！……

en.t: Those people were not aiming at the sea after all, but at this place! ...

units.source_text: 他们打的鬼主意：用不着费神捉人，就能迅速抹杀掉我呀！……

en.t: That was their filthy scheme: they could wipe me out quickly without going to the trouble of catching me! ...
Yes, wipe me out, exactly that ...

units.source_text: 就是魔术师的手绢也没有这么高超……

en.t: Not even a magician's handkerchief could vanish something so brilliantly ...

units.source_text: 来一阵风，就能把什么都刮得无影无踪……

en.t: One gust of wind, and it could sweep everything away without a trace ...

units.source_text: 连比赛得一等奖的警犬，也敌不过……

en.t: Even a police dog that had won first prize in a competition would be no match for it ...

units.source_text: 那些家伙们，现在怎么可能若无其事地出现呢！……

en.t: How could those people possibly show up now as if nothing had happened! ...

units.source_text: 什么也没看见，什么也没听到……

en.t: They saw nothing, they heard nothing ...

units.source_text: 一个傻瓜外乡人，稀里糊涂地迷了路，就此消失了……

en.t: A foolish outsider lost his way in a daze and simply disappeared ...

units.source_text: 那些家伙们的手一点也没弄脏，就解决了一个……

en.t: Those people settled the matter without getting their hands dirty in the slightest ...
